## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
